note: Brunei: the Immigration and National Registration Department's foreign work pass division takes applications for the work visa and pass (Pas Kerja) on the employer's or sponsor's letter, with the Labour Department's foreign worker licence (LPA, form BUR 500), its licence to recruit foreign workers and its job order, for every category of applicant, Singaporeans and Malaysians included (who need no visa form). No performers' route or exemption was found, so no days are modelled. Read on the Department's own page.

sources.title: Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan (Brunei), Pas Kerja
sources.said: Bahagian Pas Kerja Asing bertanggungjawab untuk menerima dan memproses: ... Permohonan visa/pas kerja ... Lesen Pekerja Asing (LPA)/Borang BUR 500 dan Lesen Pengambilan Pekerja Asing dari Jabatan Buruh (asal dan salinan) mestilah disertakan oleh semua kategori pemohon.
